MetricClient interface. Internal client for the Fabric Metrics search API (POST /fabric/v4/metrics/search).

    • search

    • getMetricsByName

      List<Metric> getMetricsByName(String name, String value)
      Retrieves metrics by wildcard metric name (GET /fabric/v4/metrics). Only the wildcard metro metric types are supported by this endpoint (for example equinix.fabric.metro.*.latency). This endpoint does not support time-range filtering.
      Parameters:
      name - the wildcard metric name (required)
      value - which value to retrieve (for example last; required)
      Returns:
      the matching metrics

    • getMetricsByAssetId

      List<Metric> getMetricsByAssetId(String asset, String assetId, String name, LocalDateTime fromDateTime, LocalDateTime toDateTime)
      Retrieves metrics for a specific asset (GET /fabric/v4/{asset}/{assetId}/metrics).
      Parameters:
      asset - the asset type (for example ports, connections, or metros)
      assetId - the asset uuid
      name - the metric name (required)
      fromDateTime - optional start of the time range, or null
      toDateTime - optional end of the time range, or null
      Returns:
      the matching metrics for the asset
